_comment: Brave Search: fallback web search for non-arXiv sources. Used by source-searcher when sources.yml has Brave enabled — useful for finding GitHub repositories, technical reports, ACL Anthology papers, and gray literature that is not indexed by arXiv or Semantic Scholar. Requires a Brave Search API key.
_usage: Filter results to academic domains in source-searcher: site:arxiv.org OR site:aclanthology.org OR site:openreview.net OR site:proceedings.mlr.press OR site:github.com
